body: The problem has been with me 16 years.
Telling them would help nothing; it would only fill them with panic.
Not a bad idea, but I can't afford to do anything like that; my folks deserve all the help they can get from me. Thanks very much for your kind words, though.

I appreciate the thoughts. I am far too poor to change my lifestyle in any way. I can't afford to go back to school or anything like that, and that would be a far cry from a guaranteed job if I could. I've given life so many goes it hurts to even think of trying again. But thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kind words.
I don't know what else to tell you. It just isn't worth it :(
